tests.name: Actual admin helper sends negative usage, not a rollover benefit grant
POLARSH_ENVIRONMENT=sandbox does not switch the existing SDK helper
Explicit SDK server=sandbox selects the sandbox endpoint
Retries preserve the recipient and caller-provided external ID
Invalid grants do not call the SDK transport
Free accounts are eligible for all three existing rollover pack definitions
Current checkout ignores an extra recipient field and keeps the buyer as customer
Swapping checkout user to the recipient also swaps customer email and order identity
Existing REST checkout honors sandbox mode, unlike the shared SDK helper

limitations: Provider responses are fixtures; external deduplication and payment behavior are not tested.

tests.name: Negative usage grant with no rollover benefit is lost at reset
Negative gift adjustment on a paid allowance is lost at reset
Existing rollover credits do not make a negative gift adjustment permanent
Non-rollover allowance is spent before rollover credits
Usage beyond the allowance reduces remaining rollover credits
Native pack keeps 30000 remaining credits across three plan renewals
Native benefit revocation subtracts its last grant amount, not remaining pack usage
Naming a user event meter.credited does not turn it into a native credit grant

limitations: Repository queries, persistence, timestamps, and provider infrastructure are fixtures.
This executes selected upstream methods, not the hosted Polar sandbox.
The hosted service may run a different revision.
Cancellation, upgrade, downgrade, real checkout, provider deduplication, and refund webhook delivery are not tested.

hostedPolarSandbox.reason: No sandbox organization access token is available.

decision: Do not use negative ai_usage adjustments to deliver permanent gifts. Native recipient grants need a hosted sandbox proof; a durable application gift balance is the fallback.
cleanup: Temporary experiment workspaces removed; no persistent test servers, databases, containers, or networks created.
